text.p: South African Desvonde Botes shot a course record nine-under-par 63 after dropping a shot on his opening hole of the Royal Swazi Open on Thursday.
Botes, 22, fired two eagles and six birdies to finish two shots clear of compatriot Steve van Vuuren.
Botes, who won the Zambian Open last year, took full advantage of the preferred lies in operation over the picturesque Swaziland layout to post his lowest round in tournament golf.
He recovered from a bogey five at his first hole, the 10th, to turn in 31, after eagling both 12 and 17. He then birdied three of his final four holes.
"I played pretty well today but I still missed three six-footers for birdie," said Botes.
